rows.what_the_ink_shows: The manuscript has U_ν(G) est, crosses through « can. isomorphe », and places « identique » above the cancellation (crops/46_scan019_L896_identity.png). The continuation visibly reads « au voisinage infinitésimal d’ordre p^ν de la section unité »; the p has a raised ν, with no −1 or ideal-power notation added (crops/46_scan019_L896_neighbourhood.png). This matches the supplied original transcription, including its deletion and insertion.
rows.note: Preserve the written identification with « au voisinage infinitésimal d’ordre p^ν ». The supplied intended refinement defines U_ν(G) using the Frobenius power I^[p^ν] of the ideal of the unit section, states that it contains the (p^ν−1)-th infinitesimal neighbourhood and is contained in the d(p^ν−1)-th, and restricts equality with an infinitesimal neighbourhood to relative dimension at most one. That mathematical refinement is supplied by the correction row and was not independently proved here.
